#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile Protocol Z correspondence into a single bundled PDF"""
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter

def create_compiled_pdf(output_path):
    c = canvas.Canvas(output_path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    
    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 18)
    c.drawString(width/2 - 200, height - 60, "PROTOCOL Z CORRESPONDENCE")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Oblique", 11)
    c.drawString(width/2 - 220, height - 85, "For: counsel@lawfirm.example")
    
    # Divider
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    c.line(50, height - 110, width - 50, height - 110)
    
    y = height - 150
    font = "Helvetica"
    fs = 11
    
    # Section 1
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", fs)
    c.drawString(50, y, "1. Initial Vendor Draft - Oct 3, 2026")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.drawString(80, y - 16, "   From: vendor@vendor.com")
    c.drawString(80, y - 32, "   Content: Please see the attached draft and comment.")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.8, 0.3, 0.2)
    c.drawString(80, y - 48, "   [PRIVILEGED: ATTORNEY-CLIENT]")
    c.setFillColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
    c.line(50, y - 64, width - 50, y - 64)
    
    # Section 2
    y -= 35
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", fs)
    c.drawString(50, y, "2. Internal Discussion Thread - Oct 3, 2026")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.drawString(80, y - 16, "   leadnegotiator@company.com forwarded vendor message with notes.")
    c.drawString(80, y - 32, "   CC: other@company.com, me@company.com")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.8, 0.3, 0.2)
    c.drawString(80, y - 48, "   [Thread marked: ATTORNEY-CLIENT]")
    c.setFillColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
    c.line(50, y - 64, width - 50, y - 64)
    
    # Section 3
    y -= 35
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", fs)
    c.drawString(50, y, "3. Legal Assistant Bundle Preparation - Oct 10, 2026")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.drawString(80, y - 16, "   From: legal-assistant@company.com")
    c.drawString(80, y - 32, "   Prepared: ProtocolZ_bundle_all.pdf (full)")
    c.drawString(80, y - 48, "              ProtocolZ_bundle_redacted.pdf (redacted)")
    c.setFont(font, fs)
    c.drawString(80, y - 64, "   Ready for external review distribution.")
    
    # End
    y -= 40
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 12)
    c.drawString(50, y, "=" * 50)
    c.drawString(50, y - 30, "END OF CORRESPONDENCE")
    
    c.save()
    return output_path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = create_compiled_pdf("/workspace/ProtocolZ_correspondence_bundled.pdf")
    print(f"PDF created: {result}")
